name: Laranjal Paulista (Brazil)
description: Vertical triband of blue, white and blue in the proportions 28:34:28, charged at the centre with the municipal arms.
history: Laranjal Paulista is a municipality in the state of São Paulo, Brazil. The flag was adopted on 28 September 1971 (prescribed by Law No. 1,130 of 28 September 1971, the arms by Law No. 301 of 23 December 1959, according to Flags of the World).

features.role: municipal arms with a mural crown, a shield with a torch, a saw and towers, over a scroll reading SERVIENDO PATRIAE REX
